summary: John's 6th-great-grand-aunt (sister of Ensign Thomas); founder with her husband of Plymouth's Davenport clan.
bio:
Charity Lamoreux (1759-1848), sister of Ensign Thomas, married her first cousin Thomas Davenport (1749-1812); they came to Plymouth in 1794. Their sons were the 'Davenport congress'. Their daughters Phoebe (m. John Pringle) and Hannah (m. Jacob Gould; mother of Charity Gould Pringle) married into the Pringles.

FamilySearch attaches a New York christening index entry for 'Charity Lamoreau', baptized 27 Mar 1760 at Philipstown (born 26 Jan 1759), and gives her death date as 4 Oct 1848. Her 1820 census entry is as Charity Davenport ([R4-S1]). The baptism confirms the Philipstown connection of Jean's family.
